messages:
maria (People Ops): Dropping a follow-up thread from today's all-hands about hybrid + offsite logistics. Post any blips we missed (travel windows, reimbursements, desks, accessibility). I'll summarize answers later.

kevin (Eng): Two quick ones: 1) If I tack on personal days after the offsite, can I still check a bag and get reimbursed for work portion? 2) Can we ship laptops to the offsite location instead of carrying them?

maria (People Ops): Short: 1) Only the business travel portion is reimbursable. If combined itineraries are cheaper and include personal days, tag Finance+People Ops for pre-approval. 2) Laptop shipping is allowed for dedicated equipment — submit an IT shipping request at least 10 business days prior.

tara (Design): Is there any support for caregivers beyond emergency childcare reimbursement? Any plan for on-site caregiving pods?

sophia (CEO): We heard this loud and clear. We're piloting a caregiver reimbursement for the fall offsite and evaluating on-site caregiver options for larger events. Details to be published with the RSVP.

henry (Sales): Do sales folks on quota-trips have different travel windows? We have customer calls the week after offsite sometimes.

finance-bot: Policy note: business-essential travel windows can be adjusted for customer-critical roles. Please route exceptions through Finance & People Ops when booking. Use expense code OFFSITE-2026.

claire (Office Ops): Desk booking update: HQ will reserve a set of hoteling blocks for teams that publish core days. If you need a recurring desk for a sprint, submit a hoteling request and we'll allocate up to 10 business days.

it-bot: IT reminder: if you need VPN or network access for remote hotel locations, open an IT ticket with location details 5 business days ahead. We can also pre-stage rented devices.

kevin (Eng): Thanks  if someone is traveling from outside the country and needs a visa letter, what's the lead time?

maria (People Ops): Ideally 6+ weeks. We can provide invitation letters, coordinate with Legal, and help escalate urgent cases. DM me ASAP if you're in that bucket.

tara (Design): Accessibility question: will there be captioning/ASL for talks? I know a couple teammates requested it earlier.

sophia (CEO): Yes  accessibility services requested in the RSVP will be booked (captioning/ASL/quiet rooms). Please flag specific needs on the RSVP form or DM People Ops. We want the event to be accessible.

henry (Sales): One more  who signs off on partner/vendor badges for offsite days at HQ?

claire (Office Ops): Vendors need a sponsor + badge request 72h in advance. For multiple-day partner visits, use the visitor intake form so we can schedule escorts and meeting rooms.

maria (People Ops): Wrapping up: I'll post a condensed FAQ with links (badge portal, travel policy, IT shipping request, RSVP) by EOD. If your question needs a long answer, ping me and we'll hop on a quick call. :thumbsup:
